what: Resize PDF Pages changes the paper size of the pages in a PDF. It is useful when a document made for US Letter must be printed on A4, or the other way round, or when pages of different sizes need to match.

You decide how the content fits: scaled to fit entirely on the new page, scaled to fill the page and trimmed at the edges, or kept at its size and centred on the new paper. A white margin can be added around the content.
Pages are changed directly in the PDF with pdf-lib, so text stays selectable and sharp. Nothing is uploaded.
uses: Print a document from another country on your local paper without cut-off edges.
Make every page of a merged PDF the same size.
Shrink the content slightly to leave a safe margin for binding or for printers that cannot print to the edge.
Scale an A4 page up to A3 or a custom size for printing larger.
Meet a portal or publisher rule that asks for a specific page size.
tutorial: Click the box or drop the PDF on it. A note shows the current page sizes, for example "All 12 pages are Letter".
Choose A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5, B5 or Tabloid, or Custom size to type a width and height in mm, inches or points.
"Same as each page" keeps tall pages tall and wide pages wide. Or force portrait or landscape.
Fit shows the whole page; Fill covers the paper; Keep the content size just changes the paper around it.
Type a margin in millimetres for Fit or Keep size, for example 10.
Leave "Pages to change" empty for all pages, or type a list like 1-3, 7.
Press Resize pages and then Download resized PDF.
features: A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5, B5, Tabloid or any size you type.
Fit, Fill or keep the content size.
Add a white border around the content.
Change only the pages you choose.

example.title: Worked example: a US report printed in Europe
example.text: Elena receives report.pdf in US Letter size and wants to print it on A4 without losing the page numbers at the bottom. She opens it, sees "All 20 pages are Letter", leaves A4 and "Fit the whole page" selected, types 5 for the margin and presses Resize pages. The message says "Changed 20 pages to A4", and the printed pages show everything with a small white edge.

tips: Use Fit when nothing may be cut off, such as forms and invoices.
Use Fill for full-bleed designs like flyers, where a little trimming is fine.
Check the result in a PDF reader before printing many copies.
For Letter to A4, the content shrinks only about 3%, which is hard to notice.
problems: You probably chose a margin or a much bigger paper with "Keep the content size". Use Fit with a smaller margin.
Fill cuts off what does not fit. Switch to Fit to see the whole page.
Each side must be at least 13 mm (half an inch).
